title: Demand and supply: an income rise bids the price up
subject: economics

scenes.caption: The market starts in equilibrium
scenes.narration: Supply and demand cross at the equilibrium. Follow the market marker as it climbs the supply curve and settles where the two curves meet.

shape.explain: Price axis: higher up means a higher price.
Quantity axis: further right means a larger quantity.
Label: the vertical axis measures price.
Label: the horizontal axis measures quantity.
Supply curve: as price rises, firms offer more for sale, so the curve slopes up.
Label: S is the supply curve.
Demand curve: as price falls, buyers want more, so the curve slopes down.
Label: D is the demand curve.
Equilibrium price guide: the price at which supply equals demand.
Equilibrium quantity guide: the amount traded at the equilibrium price.
Label: P1, the starting equilibrium price.
Label: Q1, the starting equilibrium quantity.
Market marker: watch it travel along the supply curve to the equilibrium.

steps.text: Equilibrium E1: at price P1 the quantity supplied equals the quantity demanded, Q1.

scenes.caption: Incomes rise and demand shifts right
scenes.narration: Consumer income rises. For a normal good, buyers now want more at every price, so the whole demand curve shifts right. Supply does not move.

shape.explain: Price axis: higher up means a higher price.
Quantity axis: further right means a larger quantity.
Label: the vertical axis measures price.
Label: the horizontal axis measures quantity.
Supply curve: as price rises, firms offer more for sale, so the curve slopes up.
Label: S is the supply curve.
The old demand curve, before incomes rose.
Demand curve on the move: the whole curve shifts right when a condition of demand changes.
Label: the named condition change - a rise in consumer income for a normal good.
Shift arrow: demand moves right, to a larger quantity at every price.
Label: D2, the new demand curve after the shift.
Label: D1, the original demand curve.

steps.text: Only demand shifts: a condition of demand changed, so the whole curve moves - this is not a movement along the curve.

scenes.caption: A shortage opens at the old price
scenes.narration: At the old price P1, buyers on the new demand curve want Qd, but firms still supply only Qs along the unchanged supply curve. The gap between them is a shortage.

shape.explain: Price axis: higher up means a higher price.
Quantity axis: further right means a larger quantity.
Label: the vertical axis measures price.
Label: the horizontal axis measures quantity.
Supply curve: as price rises, firms offer more for sale, so the curve slopes up.
Label: S is the supply curve.
The new demand curve D2, after the income rise shifted demand right.
Label: D2, the shifted demand curve.
The old price P1, held fixed for the moment after demand has shifted.
Label: P1, the old equilibrium price.
Quantity supplied at P1: firms offer Qs, read off the supply curve.
Quantity demanded at P1: buyers want Qd, read off the new demand curve.
Guide: Qs drops from the supply curve to the quantity axis.
Guide: Qd drops from the new demand curve to the quantity axis.
Label: Qs, the quantity supplied at the old price.
Label: Qd, the quantity demanded at the old price.
Shortage gap: watch it stretch from Qs to Qd - demand exceeds supply at P1.
Label: the shortage - quantity demanded exceeds quantity supplied at P1.

steps.text: At P1 there is a shortage: Qd exceeds Qs, so unsatisfied buyers compete for the good.

scenes.caption: Competition bids the price up to a new equilibrium
scenes.narration: Competing buyers bid the price up. The market marker climbs along the unchanged supply curve in steps until it settles at the new equilibrium, where the new demand curve crosses supply.

Quantity axis: further right means a larger quantity.
Label: the vertical axis measures price.
Label: the horizontal axis measures quantity.
Supply curve: as price rises, firms offer more for sale, so the curve slopes up.
Label: S is the supply curve.
The new demand curve D2: the price rises until this curve crosses supply.
Label: D2, the shifted demand curve.
The old equilibrium, left behind as the price is bid up.
Price marker: watch it climb the supply curve as buyers bid the price up.
New equilibrium price guide: the higher price P2 clears the market.
New equilibrium quantity guide: the larger quantity Q2 is traded at P2.
Label: P2, the new, higher equilibrium price.
Label: Q2, the new, larger equilibrium quantity.
New equilibrium E2: the new demand curve crosses supply here.

steps.text: New equilibrium E2: the price is bid up along supply until the shortage closes - price P2, quantity Q2.
